boundary.what: a boundary that is inclusive: the item is reordered when on_hand EQUALS the reorder point, not only below it
boundary.wrong_does: compares with < : an item exactly at the reorder point is not flagged

rounding.what: a rounding rule unlike the rest of the module: ties go to the even cent, stated through the premise
rounding.wrong_does: rounds half up, as apply_discount and total do

empty.what: an empty input that is an error: an average of nothing raises, although the neighbouring total() returns 0.00

order.what: the order of the checks: with two reasons to refuse, the SKU mismatch is the one reported
order.wrong_does: calls reserve() first, so a wrong article with too large a quantity is reported as a stock shortage
